NPC Đinh Sóc / NPC-HN-GATE-WARDEN. Preserve compact dark hair, young adult face, dark blue-green robe, light copper duty shoulder marks, hip route tag and accepted short slim spear held low diagonal. Do not upscale the shaft to an overhead long spear, add helmet/shield/armor, or switch the tag side.

ALL18poses remain NORTHWEST back-left three-quarter facing screen up-left, identical rear camera and body axes to IMAGE1. Show the back-left view throughout all18poses. Only the original free physical hand checks the route tag. Do not reuse Southeast screen-left wording as handedness after rotation. Root/ground is between the boot soles, never the spear tip; low tip may extend into transparent padding below ground.

Rear profession occlusion: Free-hand tag check stays on the same hip/front-side placement; naturally hidden front fingers are not rendered through the back. Spear on the physical flank may remain visible at silhouette, with anatomically correct hand/shaft occlusion. Never swing the weapon across the back or face to demonstrate the action.

Motion is stationary with stable boots and genuine small pose changes; no six static duplicate images, full-body bobbing/scaling or camera rotation. Any naturally lower bounds while looking down remain natural, not normalized. New view/action is a candidate for review; owner acceptance of Southeast does not approve seven new views or runtime.
